statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of transient neurological deficits consistent with prior transient ischemic attacks
The patient has a known history of cerebral infarction
The patient has nonrheumatic mitral valve insufficiency
The monitoring is to evaluate for potential paroxysmal atrial fibrillation or other arrhythmias
The arrhythmias may be contributing to embolic events
The diagnosis codes are G45.9, I34.0, and Z86.73
The claim was denied under reason code CO-97
The submitted materials do not align with the records currently maintained in the insurer's system
